title: Steampunk Texture Concept Update 1.20+
description: Steampunk Texture Pack from legacy console updated to newer versions
body: ![Steampunk Texture Pack Support for Newer Versions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce429cb5adff42ee9e56e21e88c85facdbff1681_0.webp)Steampunk Texture Concept Update 1.20+ is a Unofficial Continuation resource pack of the Steampunk Texture Pack by 4J Studios, the original pack have been discontinued since 1.19, This resource pack changes the look of the newer blocks, items and mobs of what if the Steampunk Texture Pack continued updating after 1.19? This is supposed work with the overlay of the Steampunk Texture Pack and will NOT work properly without it.
